messages:
rhea-fin: Noticed an oddity in the metering audit: a batch of requests that hit the ratecap window were retried by the gateway and both the original and retry became billable token events. Looks like double-counting during short bursts.

matt-eng: can you point to the time window and sample query?

rhea-fin: window: 2024-10-05T02:10:00Z - 2024-10-05T02:20:00Z. Quick query: `SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM token_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2024-10-05' AND '2024-10-05' AND request_meta->>'retry' = 'true' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;` shows several accounts with large retry-token totals.

kevin-infra: tee-ing into logs now. Gateway shows a short retry storm when the ratecap gate returned 429s and the client library retried without idempotency. Ingest accepted both attempts.

julia-sales: which customers are impacted? we have one on a renewal call this morning.

rhea-fin: top hit: StellarMaps (acct_901) +2.2M duplicate tokens, WaveLabs (acct_772) +1.4M, MicroGrain (acct_654) +620k. At our token rate that's roughly $6,450 overcharge total.

billing-bot: Metering anomaly: token_duplication_detected for acct_901. Ticket INC-4022 opened.

matt-eng: root cause short: client retries during transient 429s + gateway didn't attach idempotency-key on retry path. The ingest layer also lacked dedupe checks for a small legacy shard. Patch ready: `gateway@fix/retry-idempotency` and `ingest@fix/dedupe-shard`.

kevin-infra: mitigation plan: 1) deploy idempotency header to gateway canary 2) enable ingest dedupe on legacy shard 3) run a dedupe-replay to collapse duplicate token_events for the burst window 4) emit per-account diffs and publish to billing S3.

rhea-fin: request: finance sign-off to issue provisional credits to the affected invoices while we execute the dedupe. Proposed provisional total $6,450. We'll reconcile after replay and either re-invoice or reverse credits.

marc-finance: Approving provisional credits of $6,450. Please annotate invoice lines with: "Provisional credit issued pending dedupe and metering reconciliation." Billing ops to apply provisional lines and link to INC-4022.

julia-sales: I'll reach out to StellarMaps and WaveLabs with a short note: "We've identified a transient retry-related duplicate in usage reporting. We've issued a provisional credit while we verify and reconcile. We'll follow up with final numbers." Keep it calm. :thumbsup:

billing-ops: Received note. We need the replay CSV to apply provisional adjustments. Please ensure replay includes: account_id, original_tokens, deduped_tokens, token_delta, invoice_id.

kevin-infra: kicking off dedupe job now. Job id: dedupe-1841234567. SQL used (summary): `WITH grouped AS (SELECT request_id, chunk_seq, array_agg(id ORDER BY created_at) as ids FROM token_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2024-10-05T02:10:00Z' AND '2024-10-05T02:20:00Z' GROUP BY request_id, chunk_seq HAVING count(*) > 1) SELECT te.account_id, count(*) as dup_count, sum(te.tokens) as dup_tokens FROM token_events te JOIN grouped g ON te.id = ANY(g.ids) GROUP BY te.account_id;` Uploading CSV to s3://redwood-billing/replays/1841234567-dedupe.csv when finished. ETA ~90m.

billing-bot: Dedupe job scheduled: dedupe-1841234567. Will post completion and S3 link.

kevin-infra: canary deploy successful. ingest dedupe enabled on legacy shard. Running full dedupe now.

billing-ops: after we get the CSV we'll apply provisional credits as separate invoice lines with note and attach the replay file to INC-4022. Also request confirmation that the dedupe job includes an audit token so we can audit revert if needed.

matt-eng: dedupe job completed. Uploaded diff: s3://redwood-billing/replays/1841234567-dedupe.csv. Summary: StellarMaps delta -2,213,784 tokens, WaveLabs -1,402,190, MicroGrain -619,841, others -278,120.

rhea-fin: received. billing-ops: please ingest CSV and apply provisional adjustments. Finance will reconcile in the next billing run and either re-invoice for recovered tokens or reverse provisional credits if the dedupe reduces billable usage.

billing-bot: Tickets updated: INC-4022 attached replay link. Billing ops assigned.
